[[File:Leather gloves detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Leather gloves''' are basic [[gloves]] worn in the [[hands slot]], offering slight defensive bonuses. Making them requires 1 [[Crafting]], 1 [[leather]], 1 [[thread]], and a [[needle]], yielding 13.8 Crafting [[experience]].
